none: PAS NLM-18F228: Roman Coin: Radiate of Carausius
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Probably a radiate of Carausius (286-293), though struck on an atypically thick flan which might leave an identification as an earlier dupondius open. Obverse description: Radiate head right. Obverse inscription: IMP CARA[VS]IVS [--]. Reverse description: Figure standing ?right with vertical spear, possibly Virtus. Reverse inscription: [---]VG. Diameter: 20.4mm, Weight: 4.16gms, die axis: probably 12
